business.title: For business
business.subtitle: Add your lodging, restaurant or activity to Papudo's travel guide.
business.pitchTitle: Visitors are already looking for where to stay, eat and what to do
business.pitchBody: Papudo en tu mano brings together the commune's beaches, routes and trips. Your business can show up right when someone plans their day.

free.title: Free listing
free.body: Your business name, description, opening hours and contact in the guide.

verified.title: Verified information
verified.body: We check your details with you, so visitors trust what they see.

routes.title: In routes and trips

directions.title: Get directions
directions.body: A direct button to phone navigation.

qr.title: Your QR for the shop
qr.body: A printable poster so your customers discover Papudo.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.body: How many people viewed your listing and asked for directions (coming soon).

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.body: Tell us what you offer and where you are.

verify.title: We verify
verify.body: We confirm location, hours and contact with you.

publish.title: We publish
publish.body: Your listing appears in the guide, in Spanish and English.

business.muniTitle: For the Municipality and the Chamber of Commerce
business.muniBody: An up-to-date tourism inventory, sourced and verified information, and usage metrics to measure each season's impact.
business.notOpen: This is a test version: business sign-ups are not open yet. The places you see in the guide are samples, built from public data with their sources.

qr.help: The QR opens the guide and tells us which shop the visit came from, with no personal data.
qr.headline: Discover Papudo from your phone
qr.qrAlt: QR code to the Papudo en tu mano guide
qr.scan: Scan with your camera: beaches, routes and trips, no download needed.

live.title: Live trip
live.gpsDenied: We don't have permission to use your location. Enable it in your browser settings to follow the live trip.
live.gpsUnavailable: We couldn't get your location. Check that GPS is on.
live.mapUnavailable: The map isn't available, but the guide below still works.
live.straightLineNote: Straight-line distance: the real path may be longer. To follow streets, open Google Maps.
live.noCompass: No compass: your destination is to the {direction}. Walk a few steps and the arrow will follow your movement.
live.cameraOff: No camera access: the guide still works.
live.cameraSafety: Watch the path and take care when crossing. The arrow is approximate (GPS ± 5–15 m).
live.demoBanner: Demo mode: your location is simulated and moves on its own towards the next stop. Turn your phone to try the camera arrow.
live.cameraFar: See the direction with the camera
live.nearestHint: You're closer to {name} ({distance}). Want to start there?
live.cameraOffHint: If you opened the link from WhatsApp or Instagram, open it in Chrome or Safari and allow camera access.
